verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a choice of funding model: there is no mention of prefunded balances as a selectable option, no just-in-time funding of individual authorizations, and no documented cash-flow tradeoffs. Collaborative authorization (real-time approve/decline) and the integrated ledger are adjacent controls. Neither shows that the subscriber's system funds each authorization, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can choose how transactions are funded — prefunded balances or just-in-time funding where my system approves and funds each authorization — with the cash-flow tradeoffs documented
